Q3 Field Report

Bramble Analytics closed the third quarter with revenue up 12% quarter over quarter, driven mainly by renewals in the logistics segment. Headcount stayed flat at 48. The board asked for a deeper look at churn in the SMB tier before the next meeting, so that analysis leads the appendix.

Appendix: SMB churn

SMB churn moved from 3.1% to 4.4% quarter over quarter. Support ticket volume in that segment rose 18%, and the median time to first response went from 6 hours to 11 hours. The working theory is that response time, not price, is driving the increase.
